items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: And I remember meeting once at Ryan’s, Albert Nicholas.

ctx.x: And Eddie Condon. Now there was Condon’s and there was Jimmy Ryan’s. When I came in ’48, or ’47 actually, the original Ryan’s was there and Eddie Condon’s was there and Nick’s was there. So I went to all of those places.
